scripts.test:zsh: tmo() { if command -v perl >/dev/null 2>&1; then perl -e '$t=shift;$p=fork;if(!$p){setpgrp(0,0);open STDIN,"</dev/null" if -t STDIN;exec @ARGV;exit 127}%n=(INT,2,TERM,15,HUP,1);for my $g(keys %n){$SIG{$g}=sub{kill $g,-$p;waitpid($p,0);exit 128+$n{$g}}}$SIG{ALRM}=sub{kill 9,-$p;waitpid($p,0);print STDERR "TIMEOUT: killed after ${t}s: @ARGV\n";exit 124};alarm $t;waitpid($p,0);exit($?&127?128+($?&127):$?>>8)' "${TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT:-900}" "$@"; else "$@"; fi; }; FAILED=; for f in tests/test_*.sh tests/test_*.zsh tests/sv-large-campaign/test-*.zsh; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "=== $f ==="; case "$(head -1 "$f")" in *zsh*) tmo zsh "$f";; *) tmo bash "$f";; esac || FAILED="$FAILED $f"; done; if [ -n "$FAILED" ]; then echo "FAILING FILES:$FAILED"; exit 1; fi
scripts.test:full: npm run test:fast && npm run test:zsh
